correctness.rationale: Verified the 12 vertices, six square faces and eight triangles, the dichotomy N=8 iff largest absolute directional coordinate exceeds the other two, and the Cauchy face-area formula A=4a+2b+2c (octagon) or 3(a+b+c) (hexagon). The 24 spherical cones have area arcsin(1/3); the sphere Laplacian/divergence identity gives chamber first moments Ix=pi/(6sqrt3), Iy=Iz=pi/8−pi/(6sqrt3), hence the weighted octagonal integral pi/2. Thus E[A;N8]=3 and E[A;N6]=sqrt3 by total surface area (12+4sqrt3)/4. Exact inequalities imply Cov(A,N)<0. Independently rebuilt projected planar convex hulls of 480 generic views with max area error 2.7e−15; separate angular quadrature reproduces cone area and first moments. These finite checks corroborate, but only the analytic proof covers all Haar directions.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate exact identities only; all-parameter assertions depend on the reconstructed proof and named published premises.
